title: Shadow Chase
shareTitle: Shadow Chase — A Toy Theatre of Light
description: Match six carved animals to their silhouettes, slide a wooden sun to make long and short shadows, and play a whole day of light in a warm tabletop toy theatre.
learningGoals: Discriminate an object's silhouette from two nearby shape distractors
Discover that a low light makes a long shadow and a high light makes a short one
Observe that a cast shadow points away from its light source
Compare how one object's shadow changes from morning through noon to evening
interactionModel: Three voice-led, time-free play modes use large tactile controls: tap one of three shadow plaques, drag or tap a five-stop arched sun rail, and step or play through morning, noon, and evening. The same shadow transform responds continuously to pointer, touch, keyboard, and debug controls.
feedbackModel: Wrong choices wobble gently and reveal a shape clue after two tries; a matching silhouette lights up and earns a carved star. Sun matches accept a forgiving hold near the target, while Shadow Show stamps each visited time of day. There is no score, timer, streak, or failure state.
